original_benchmark.notes: LongBench v2 (THUDM/LongBench, arXiv:2412.15204): 503 long-context multiple-choice questions (8k-2M words) in six categories. Original harness is a direct zero-shot LLM call (pred.py) scored by accuracy (result.py).

harbor_adapter.notes: All 503 questions adapted; context shipped as /app/context.txt, answer written to /app/answer.txt, deterministic verifier that is a verbatim port of the official extract_answer (no bare-letter leniency). Dataset pinned to zai-org/LongBench-v2@2b48e494f2c7a2f0af81aae178e05c7e1dde0fe9 (data.json sha256 15d61c22d92c96900b3c4948b6aeea218d3214b676a65df48e7b8555604c7fe2, verified at generation time); prompt/scorer pinned to THUDM/LongBench@2e00731f8d0bff23dc4325161044d0ed8af94c1e. A stratified 176-task parity split is available via --split parity. Parity pending (Scenario 2: fork with a CLI-agent runner; file-reading agent protocol reported separately from the upstream single-call/truncated-context setting).
